<!doctype html>
<!-- Appearance placeholders are replaced during SSR from per-device cookies, and the native
     pane-toggles placeholder from the native app's user agent; see hooks.server.ts. -->
<html
	lang="en"
	data-type-scale
	data-amp-theme="theme-0"
	data-amp-color-scheme="system"
	data-amp-terminal-theme="app"
	data-amp-terminal-palette="gruvbox"
	data-amp-text-size="default"
	data-amp-ui-sounds="on"
	data-amp-logo-motion="on"
	data-amp-color-filters="off"
	data-amp-native-pane-toggles=""
	style=""
>
	<head>
		<meta charset="utf-8" />
		<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover" />
		<!-- Scales the root font size (and therefore the rem-based AGENTS(typeScale) type
		     scale and --spacing) with the OS/browser accessibility font-size setting on
		     browsers that support it (Chromium on Android). iOS is unaffected: WebKit
		     ignores this meta and tracks Dynamic Type via `font: -apple-system-body`
		     (server/src/app.css). Do not combine with env(preferred-text-scale); the
		     scale would apply twice. -->
		<meta name="text-scale" content="scale" />
		<style>
			:root {
				color-scheme: light dark;
				--amp-shell-light-background-color: #fafaf8;
				--amp-shell-dark-background-color: #0b0d0b;
				--amp-surface-light-background-color: #f9fdf6;
				--amp-surface-dark-background-color: #0c1516;
			}

			html[data-amp-color-scheme='light'] {
				color-scheme: light;
			}

			html[data-amp-color-scheme='dark'] {
				color-scheme: dark;
			}

			html[data-amp-theme='theme-1'] {
				--amp-shell-light-background-color: #fafafa;
				--amp-shell-dark-background-color: #0c0c0c;
				--amp-surface-light-background-color: #fcfcfc;
				--amp-surface-dark-background-color: #121212;
			}

			html[data-amp-theme='theme-4'] {
				--amp-shell-light-background-color: #fcfbf6;
				--amp-shell-dark-background-color: #090d12;
				--amp-surface-light-background-color: #fcfbf6;
				--amp-surface-dark-background-color: #0f161e;
			}

			html[data-amp-theme='theme-5'] {
				--amp-shell-light-background-color: #f8fafc;
				--amp-shell-dark-background-color: #09121c;
				--amp-surface-light-background-color: #f7f9fc;
				--amp-surface-dark-background-color: #0e1a28;
			}

			html[data-amp-theme='theme-6'] {
				--amp-shell-light-background-color: #ffffff;
				--amp-shell-dark-background-color: #000000;
				--amp-surface-light-background-color: #ffffff;
				--amp-surface-dark-background-color: #000000;
			}

			html,
			body {
				background-color: var(--amp-shell-light-background-color);
			}

			body:not([data-amp-app-mounted]) .app-shell [data-slot='sidebar-trigger'],
			.app-shell[data-app-mount-preview-loading] [data-slot='sidebar-trigger'] {
				position: relative;
				pointer-events: none;
			}

			/*
			 * Subject selectors here must be a class, not a type or `:not()` selector. Blink builds
			 * style invalidation sets from the subject's positive features; a subject with none
			 * (`:not(.sr-only)`) or a broad tag (`svg`, ~950 on a large thread) makes the
			 * `data-amp-app-mounted` flip recalculate style for most of the document (~650ms on a
			 * 12k-element thread) instead of the trigger's two children (~1ms). WebKit is
			 * unaffected either way.
			 */
			.app-shell [data-slot='sidebar-trigger'] > .app-mount-reveal {
				transform: scale(1);
				transform-origin: center;
				opacity: 1;
				transition:
					transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1),
					opacity 120ms ease-out;
			}

			body:not([data-amp-app-mounted])
				.app-shell
				[data-slot='sidebar-trigger']
				> .app-mount-reveal,
			.app-shell[data-app-mount-preview-loading]
				[data-slot='sidebar-trigger']
				> .app-mount-reveal {
				transform: scale(0.4);
				opacity: 0;
			}

			.app-shell [data-slot='sidebar-trigger']::after {
				content: '';
				position: absolute;
				top: 50%;
				left: 50%;
